 Maurice Krattenmacher 
 Media caption, Krattenmacher scores a goal for Elversberg
 Another goal for Elversberg!
 Robin Zentner punches the ball clear but it only reaches Maurice Krattenmacher who turns and slots into the bottom corner.
 Not Zentner's finest hour.

 YELLOW CARD published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 SV Elversberg 2-0 Mainz 
 Danny da Costa is booked for a foul on Francis Onyeka.
 Elversberg have another free-kick from the edge of the box.
 We know what happened with the last one but Felix Keidel blazes this one over the bar.

 GOAL - SV Elversberg 2-0 Mainz published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Francis Onyeka 
 Media caption, A second goal for Elversberg
 Francis Onyeka has his first Bundesliga goal!
 David Mokwa plays the ball into Onyeka and he is falling as he hits it but he is able to slot into the bottom corner past the diving Robin Zentner.

 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 SV Elversberg 1-0 Mainz 
 Robin Zentner fluffs his lines as the ball bobbles in front of him and rolls behind for an Elversberg corner.
 Felix Keidel whips the ball into the box but Zentner punches clear.

 Felix Keidel

 What a strike!
 Felix Keidel scores from the edge of the box with a brilliant free-kick.
 Mainz goalkeeper Robin Zentner was well beaten.
